reason: I'd probably grab one flat white to see what the new place by the subway is like, but I already have my spot and my order, and nothing here gives me a reason to change my morning. The $8 dessert lattes are not for me.
objection: I want the same good coffee fast every morning. A place built around photogenic $8 cheesecake matchas feels like it'll have weekend lines of tourists, and no drip coffee means no quick cheap cup.
would_change_my_mind: If the flat white is genuinely better than my usual and I can be in and out in two minutes, I'd consider making it a regular stop on my office days.
